etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle French advertissement (“statement calling attention”), compare French avertissement (“warning”). See advertise. Equivalent to advertise +‎ -ment.

definitions.definition: (marketing) A commercial solicitation designed to sell some commodity, service or similar.
A recommendation of a particular product, service or person.
(card games) In gin rummy, the discarding of a card of one's preferred suit so as to mislead the opponent into thinking you do not want it.

quote.citation: 1947, On Gin Rummy: An All-American Roundup, page 121:
quote.text: The safest time to answer a possible advertisement is when you have no indication as to what suit your opponent wants. Then even if he has advertised, the odds are that your answer is not the card he is looking for.
